finalText: All 12 in-repo call sites are migrated to `db.execute({ sql, params })`. The only remaining `db.query` usage is in `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`, which is explicitly marked "vendored copy... replaced wholesale on every upgrade, local changes are silently lost" — so I left it alone rather than edit code that'll just get overwritten. That's why `db.query` still needs to stay in `lib/db.js` as deprecated-but-functional rather than being removed outright. Let me know if you want a different approach there (e.g., wrapping the vendor adapter instead of patching it).
